summary.text: Citizens can go to polyclinics, and some cardholders can also go to CHAS clinics. Permanent Residents can go to polyclinics.

details.heading: Singapore Citizens
details.body: You can get subsidised referrals at polyclinics. If you hold a CHAS, Merdeka Generation, or Pioneer Generation card, you can also get them at CHAS clinics.

details.heading: Permanent Residents
details.body: You can get subsidised referrals at polyclinics.

details.heading: Healthier SG enrolment
details.body: You do not need to enrol in Healthier SG to get subsidised referrals.
